C1360.title: Value DeFi vSwap Invariant Miscalculation Exploit
C1360.summary: On May 8, 2021, Value DeFi's vSwap AMM non-50/50 pools were exploited via improper use of the Bancor formula power() function, causing miscalculation of the weighted constant product invariant. The attacker crafted input violating the baseN>=baseD assumption to bypass enforcement, draining 9 non-proportional pools for ~$11M.
